name: Honda Ruckus
engine: 49 cc liquid-cooled single, carb (to 2017) or fuel injection, CVT belt drive
intro: A cult 50 cc scooter. Starting problems usually trace to the battery, fuel filter or carb.

add.title: Check the drive belt and final drive oil
add.instructions: Measure the CVT belt width against spec and check the final drive oil level at the check bolt.
add.reason: A worn belt slips, and low final drive oil wears the gears.

G: If it dies when cold or won't climb hills, clean the carb and replace the fuel filter first.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Starting
known.what: A weak battery is a frequent cause of no-start. Tight valves can also cause trouble.
